newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: PORTUGUESE BONDS TRACK U.S. TREASURIES HIGHER.
newsitem.headline: PORTUGUESE BONDS TRACK U.S. TREASURIES HIGHER.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Portuguese shares tracked U.S. Treasuries higher, extending gains at the close, buoyed by a weakening in the dollar, dealers said. Market seen rising tomorrow.
*Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 69 bps vs 69 bps
Portuguese bonds closed higher in sympathy with Bonos and Bunds after U.S. Treasuries rallied on a weakening dollar and analysts said the market could strengthen tomorrow.
"The market was strong at the close, recovering from a weaker finish yesterday, showing that the correction was technical and has been surpassed," said one analyst.
Another said: "The possibility of a rise in U.S. rates has receded, the dollar weakened, U.S. Treasuries recovered, clearing the clouds from the sky, and helping the European markets."
